---
title: "IRSS Bibliographic Summary"
output: html_document
date: "`r Sys.Date()`"
---

**This bibliographic summary was generated using data from Web of Science**

# List of IRSS Journals

* [Scientific Journal Rank (SJR)](https://www.scimagojr.com/journalrank.php)

* [Journal H-index](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/H-index)

* Number of IRSS publications in the journal

* Most recent IRSS publication in the journal (title, author, year)

```{r, echo = FALSE, warning=FALSE, message = FALSE}

csv <- read.csv("data/irss_journals_summary.csv")

DT::datatable(csv, rownames = FALSE,extensions = 'FixedColumns', options = list(pageLength = 10,autowidth = TRUE))
```

# List of IRSS Publications

```{r, echo = FALSE, warning=FALSE, message = FALSE}
library(DT)

csv <- read.csv("data/irss_articles.csv")

DT::datatable(csv, escape = FALSE, rownames = FALSE, options = list(pageLength = 10))
```
